overview: A contraction option in a commercial lease is a clause allowing a tenant to reduce the size of their leased premises during the term, providing flexibility to downsize without breaking the entire lease. It typically requires advance notice, a contraction fee, and, in some cases, repayment of unamortized leasing costs.
